Keep the rider headless, wheels absent, axle attachment holes at identical coordinates. Keep silver, gold, tan, brown, cream and black colors unchanged. This is a registered animation body sprite: do not move/redraw/recompose, do not add wheels or head. Preserve outside transparency.
assets.repair: Background extracted with image generation; retained registered 1536×1024 canvas; verified alpha zero in exterior margins.
assets.repairPrompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: supplied orange headless, wheelless motorcycle body sprite, exactly 1536x1024 canvas. Remove ALL the dark semi-transparent rectangular backdrop and colored glow behind and around the rider/motorcycle. Return true alpha=0 transparency in every area outside the hard black silhouette, including the gaps inside frame and axle holes. Solid motorcycle, clothing and metal remain fully opaque. No cast shadow, no halo, no checkerboard, no background whatsoever. Keep all orange/cream/tan/silver colors, exact pixel positions, sizes, outline, canvas padding, headless neck and empty wheel attachment positions unchanged. This registered animation sprite must align with separate wheels and head. Do not add head or wheels; do not recompose or move the object. Only fix transparency.
